sections.h2: Why regular mowing suits established gardens
paras: Older lawns on big blocks carry decades of thatch, tree roots and shade, so they respond to routine rather than rescue. A fortnightly cut keeps the grass at a steady height, shades out bindi and broadleaf weeds and holds moisture through the hot, dry summer.

Formal hedges are the same. A hedge trimmed little and often keeps its shape, while one left for a year needs hard cutting that shows. Regular lawn mowing Inner South wide, with the hedges done on the same visit, keeps the whole frontage sharp.

sections.h2: Inner South seasons and lawn conditions
paras: Hard frosts from May to August stop most lawns growing, and Red Hill, which backs onto the Red Hill nature reserve, is often the coldest of the four, so we drop to a monthly tidy through winter. From September the spring surge arrives and our lawn mowing Inner South visits move to fortnightly.

Autumn brings leaf drop from the mature deciduous trees in the older streets, and we rake, mow and remove it with the clippings. In summer we cut higher and less often so the lawn holds moisture, with water restrictions in mind.

faqs.q: Which Inner South suburbs do you cover?
faqs.a: Our lawn mowing Inner South service covers Yarralumla, Deakin, Red Hill and Narrabundah, and we also work across the neighbouring Woden Valley. Nature strips can be included in the visit, and we edge along the kerb and footpath.

faqs.q: Can you trim a long formal hedge on the same visit as the mowing?
faqs.a: Yes. Hedge trimming can be added to an Inner South mowing schedule, because a Deakin or Red Hill frontage is usually a lawn and a hedge together. We trim to a level line, tidy the base and take the cuttings away.

faqs.q: How much does mowing cost in the Inner South?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the block, the state of the lawn and what else is included, so we quote each lawn mowing Inner South job individually after seeing it. Big blocks with long hedges take longer, and quotes are free and upfront.

faqs.q: Do you take the grass clippings and green waste away?
faqs.a: Yes. Green waste removal is available with every mowing visit, and with garden maintenance and clean-ups too. If you would rather keep some clippings for compost or mulch, tell us and we will leave what you want.
